description: Numbers printed in the main text of the paper (abstract, Sections 4 to 7, Table 2, captions of Figs 4 to 6), as printed in the English manuscript, with the record and keys from which main_text.py computes each of them again.

fields.id: name of the function of main_text.py that computes the item
fields.where: place in the manuscript; a statement repeated elsewhere lists every place
fields.quantity: what the printed values are, in the order of 'printed'
fields.printed: the values as printed, as text (percentages without the sign)
fields.decimals: decimals of each printed value (one number when all are the same); the recomputed value is formatted with them
fields.compare: equal when absent; below / at_most: the text states a bound and every recomputed value must respect it; about: the text gives a rounded statement and every recomputed value must lie within 'tolerance' of it
fields.basis: rows, windows, counts or stored: see the documentation string of main_text.py
fields.key: keys of the record that are read

terms: The manuscript writes 'aperture' for the opening of a fracture and 'unconfirmed' for the unclear (U) layer. The records m_summary_formal.json and m2_summary_formal.json name standalone outcrops 'isolated'.
